endpoint_summary.summary: Generate an image from a text prompt using a selection of turbo image models.

auth_requirements.title: Auth Requirements
items: Authentication is required via Authorization header.

preconditions.title: Preconditions
items: Requires a valid Authorization header and the configured request body.
Successful requests return a Medux task record immediately. Use the task query or sync endpoints to track completion.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: Prompt text used to generate the image. Default: An isometric 3D render of a media pipeline: video, image and audio tiles flowing through a single glowing violet hub on a dark studio background, soft volumetric light, crisp product-shot detail.
fields.default_value: An isometric 3D render of a media pipeline: video, image and audio tiles flowing through a single glowing violet hub on a dark studio background, soft volumetric light, crisp product-shot detail

fields.name: code
fields.description:
response code enums:\
.. 0: ok\
.. 12: invalid input\
.. 1410: invalid model\
.. 1409: paid plan required\
.. 1401: insufficient credits\
.... 1401 ~ 1499 是 media\
.. 1404: provider error\
.. 1405: provider timeout\
.. 13: unauthenticated\
.. 16: rate limit\
.. 99: server error

examples.title: Examples
examples.request_example:
curl -X POST https://api.medux.io/api/app/v1/generate/image/text_to_image_turbo \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $MEDUX_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"height":1024,"model_id":"zimage-turbo","prompt":"An isometric 3D render of a media pipeline: video, image and audio tiles flowing through a single glowing violet hub on a dark studio background, soft volumetric light, crisp product-shot detail","width":1024}'
